people.stableFeatures: Medium-brown complexion, dark natural curls around ears/nape, full dark beard, prominent straight/angular nose, lean adult build. Beige tunic and blue mantle recur but clothing is not identity.
people.age: Adult, visually around thirty; Matthew does not fix an exact age. Ministry scenes span a few years, not decades.
people.result: Compatible through retained Matthew scenes and current-main Mark 1 baptism. No new portrait generated.

people.stableFeatures: Young adult woman, medium-brown complexion, dark tight/wavy curls at forehead, oval face, slender build, pale head covering.
people.age: Young adult; exact age unspecified. Birth and flight scenes near in narrative time.
people.result: Retained pair compatible; no new portrait generated.

people.stableFeatures: Adult man with dark natural curls, dark beard, strong nose, medium-brown skin, lean build.
people.age: Adult, exact age unspecified; no unsupported large aging between scenes.
people.result: Retained pair compatible. Not Joseph son of Jacob or Joseph of Arimathea.

people.stableFeatures: Swaddled young child with dark hair and brown complexion; face small and partly obscured.
people.age: Infant/young child; Matthew calls him a young child and does not fix exact age.
people.result: Limited detail compatible; no precise portrait anchor certified from tiny face. Not compared with Joseph as the same adult.

people.stableFeatures: Medium-brown skin, full dark/gray beard, dense longer dark curls, robust lean adult build, coarse hair garment.
people.age: Adult, visually thirties or forties; same baptism event in Mark does not justify aging.
people.result: Current-main Matthew/Mark baptism pair compatible; Matthew 11 foreground figures are messengers, not John. No new portrait generated.

people.stableFeatures: Varied brown complexions, natural dark curls, adult bearded men with varied builds, simple woven garments. Some recurring brown/cream headbands.
people.age: Adults, mostly young to middle adult. No broad aging across ministry.
people.result: Retained group compatible; occluded/off-frame men are not counted as absent. Exact name-to-face assignment is not secure and is not invented.

people.stableFeatures: Earlier Moses: older medium-brown man, gray curls, full white/gray beard, weathered face. Earlier Elijah: lean medium-brown man, angular nose, gray-black natural curls/beard. See prior Numbers/Deuteronomy and Kings audits.
people.age: Earlier narratives and later vision are not a basis for inventing ordinary centuries of aging.
people.result: The two older Transfiguration v1 figures cannot be securely assigned to these approved anchors; rejected as continuity input and replaced by a cloud-only scene. No new recognizable Moses or Elijah generated.
